_meta.what: The registered sector-to-channel exposure map (sectors.json v1.1.0) with the deterministic weighting rule the exposure page computes with. Retrieval and description only: the instrument measures press salience, not risk, and makes no forecasts; an exposure profile re-cuts published numbers by the reader's own frame and adds no new claim.
_meta.weight_rule: Shares normalize to 1; each sector's share divides equally across its registered channels; channel weight is the sum across sectors. No intra-sector channel ordering exists in the registration, so none is invented.
_meta.registration: REGISTERED 2026-08-05 on founder delegation in chat ('you do max level'); delegated-fill review per the circularity-audit precedent: the founder may amend with a dated changelog entry, never silently
_meta.citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). India Geopolitical Risk Monitor. https://igrm.in/

textiles_apparel.label: Textiles & Apparel
textiles_apparel.rationale: Export-led to US/EU; goods move via Red Sea/Suez westbound; tariff policy is the demand-side lever.

gems_jewellery.label: Gems & Jewellery
gems_jewellery.rationale: High-value trade routed through Gulf hubs (Dubai) and air/sea corridors; Gulf stability is both market and route.

pharma.label: Pharmaceuticals
pharma.rationale: US is the dominant export market (regulatory and tariff exposure); intermediates import-dependent via sea.

it_services.label: IT Services
it_services.rationale: Revenue overwhelmingly US-facing; exposure is policy and visa salience, not physical corridors.

auto_components.label: Auto & Components
auto_components.rationale: Export programs to US/EU; input chains route via Malacca; China is both supplier and policy variable.

agri_food.label: Agriculture & Food Exports
agri_food.rationale: Basmati, marine and produce exports to the Gulf and beyond move by sea; Gulf demand and Red Sea transit both bind.

energy_manufacturing.label: Energy-intensive Manufacturing
energy_manufacturing.rationale: Input-cost exposure to crude and LNG, which India imports predominantly from and through the Gulf.

chemicals.label: Chemicals & Petrochemicals
chemicals.rationale: Feedstock tied to crude complex; bulk movement by sea in both directions.

metals.label: Metals & Mining
metals.rationale: China sets the global metals cycle and trade-remedy environment; bulk cargo is corridor-dependent.

defence_aerospace.label: Defence & Aerospace
defence_aerospace.rationale: Demand and program salience track the two land-border theatres directly.

electronics.label: Electronics Manufacturing
electronics.rationale: Component chains run through East Asia via Malacca; US-China policy repositioning is the demand driver.

fmcg.label: FMCG
fmcg.rationale: Included as a LOW-exposure control: domestic demand-led, exposure mostly via input costs and packaging/freight; a sector where the engine should show weak association.

engineering_goods.label: Engineering Goods
engineering_goods.rationale: Largest export category by breadth; US/EU demand-side policy, sea freight both directions, Chinese components upstream.

marine_products.label: Marine Products & Fisheries
marine_products.rationale: Seafood exports move refrigerated by sea to the US and East Asia; corridor disruption and US import policy are the binding risks.

petroleum_refining.label: Petroleum Refining & Export
petroleum_refining.rationale: India's largest export by value: crude in from the Gulf, refined products out by sea; doubly exposed to Hormuz and the western corridors.
